 The 2027 elections are already on the horizon
 By  KEN STRACHAN KEN STRACHAN - Columnist
 Fri,11/13/26-2:24PM ,  569 Reads 
 With the 2026 November general election last week, the deadline for reporting to the secretary of state’s office is this Friday. It’s safe to say the 2027 county and state elections will be soon underway, with qualifying beginning in less than two months.
With more than 960,000 votes counted in the Senate race as of this writing, the state’s turnout rate sits at about 48.6 percent,…
